hook.text: Stripe rate limits its API with a token bucket.
hook.say: Stripe rate limits its A P I with a token bucket.

hook.text: It allows a burst, but holds the average.

bucket.text: Picture a bucket that holds 10 tokens.
bucket.say: Picture a bucket that holds ten tokens.

bucket.text: One token drips back every 6 seconds: 60 divided by 10.
bucket.say: One token drips back every six seconds: sixty divided by ten.

bucket.text: No whole token? Refused, with a time to retry.

timeline.text: At 0 seconds, 10 requests. All pass. The bucket is empty.
timeline.say: At zero seconds, ten requests. All pass. The bucket is empty.

timeline.text: At 3 seconds, half a token has dripped in. Not enough: refused.
timeline.say: At three seconds, half a token has dripped in. Not enough: refused.

timeline.text: At 6 seconds, one whole token. Allowed.
timeline.say: At six seconds, one whole token. Allowed.

timeline.text: Wait a minute or more, and it's full again. 10, never more.
timeline.say: Wait a minute or more, and it's full again. Ten, never more.

redis.text: Redis stores just two numbers: tokens, and the time.
One Lua script refills and takes a token in one step,
so two gateways never take the last token together.

takeaway.text: Bursts up to 10, then 10 a minute on average.
takeaway.say: Bursts up to ten, then ten a minute on average.

takeaway.text: So the first minute can see up to 19.
takeaway.say: So the first minute can see up to nineteen.

takeaway.text: Want fewer? Make the bucket smaller.

cta.text: Try all four in Structura's rate limiter simulator.
